Phase-1 rule: relation-first — no relation concept links a team to a score; the query asks for an attribute (score) of a known entity (the team's monthly schedule). Known-entity fallback: match the concept of the known entity, which is the monthly_schedule concept (the team's schedule for March). Source selection: monthly_schedule exposes only table as a live source, so table is LIKELY (its elements include Date, Opponent, Score, Record, and data examples show monthly sections with scores). KG is RULED-OUT because its elements (team_id, name, enwiki_title, inception, owners) do not include any score or game-level attribute. Therefore primary_source = table, fallback_source = kg (only other live source, though ruled out).
